traits.label: Overview
traits.text: Parasitic fungus that specifically infects bolete mushrooms. It transforms the host mushroom into a hard, yellowish mass covered with a yellow powdery mold. The fungus is easily recognizable by its bright yellow spore powder and its preference for growing on bolete mushrooms. It is not considered edible and often renders the host mushroom inedible as well.
